probe38.criterion: Baseline below the line-box top in em: the RR-38 last ink row with at least 35 % of the peak row, median over 18, 24 and 32 pt (regular single lines = lineAscent, mixed line = lineAscentMixed). The controls (Angsana New 0.85, Sakkal Majalla 0.78, Arabic Typesetting 0.70) must reproduce within 0.03 em, or the probe values are not used.
